## FAQ

**Q: What is UGC and how can it help my brand?**
A: UGC (User Generated Content) are authentic consumer-style videos created by creators for advertising campaigns. Unlike corporate ads, UGC generates up to 4x more engagement and greater trust. With 28+ active campaigns and 158 Fiverr reviews (4.8/5), Gisela creates UGC ads, testimonials, demos, and lifestyle content for TikTok, Reels, and Meta Ads.

**Q: What types of UGC content does Gisela create?**
A: UGC ads for TikTok and Meta with strong hooks, spokesperson videos, testimonials and reviews, product demos and how-tos, lifestyle content and B-Roll, and on-camera videos with voiceover — all in Spanish, English, or both languages, in vertical (9:16) format.

**Q: Does Gisela publish the content on her social media?**
A: No. Content is created exclusively for the contracting brand's use. The brand receives all files and rights to publish on their channels or paid ads. Content does not appear on Gisela's personal social media unless a specific brand ambassador agreement is established.

**Q: How does the work process work?**
A: 7-step process: 1) Request service and share brand details, 2) Receive proposal and quote, 3) Approve and make payment, 4) Send product if applicable, 5) Confirm brief and script (if in English), 6) Gisela records and edits, 7) Deliver publish-ready videos. Fully remote and professional.

**Q: Does Gisela include revisions?**
A: Yes, each project includes 1 to 2 revision rounds covering editing adjustments, pacing, on-screen text, or minor focus changes. Major changes like full re-recordings may have an additional cost depending on scope.

**Q: How long does content delivery take?**
A: Standard delivery is 3 to 5 business days from product receipt and brief confirmation. Larger packages may take longer. Urgent deadlines can be accommodated when communicated at project start.

**Q: What usage rights does the brand get?**
A: Organic post rights are included in all projects. Use in paid ads (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Ads, etc.) requires a separate paid usage license. Specific rights are clearly defined in each project contract.

**Q: Does Gisela work with international brands?**
A: Yes, 30+ countries served. Priority: Hispanic audiences in the USA, then Europe (including Spain), Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Asia, and all of Latin America. 28+ active campaigns, 158 Fiverr reviews (4.8/5 stars).

**Q: What languages does Gisela work in?**
A: Spanish is Gisela's native language — no word count restrictions, no script required. English content: up to 65 words per video, script must be provided by the brand. Ideal for bilingual brands targeting US and English-speaking markets.
